schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Notifications (id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT, notified_at_utc DATETIME, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Reports (id INT PRIMARY KEY, account_id INT, received_at_utc DATETIME, details NVARCHAR(MAX))
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Notifications (id, account_id, notified_at_utc, payload) SELECT n, MOD(n, 4) + 1, DATEADD(MINUTE, n, '2023-01-01T00:00:00'), CONCAT('Payload_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}
INSERT INTO Reports (id, account_id, received_at_utc, details) SELECT n, MOD(n, 4) + 1, DATEADD(MINUTE, n, '2023-01-01T00:00:00'), CONCAT('Details_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= {row_count}

calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the sorting operation and join produce the expected plan shape.
